title: Senior Frontend Engineer
summary: Build the dispatcher dashboard used by thousands of freight planners every day.
description: You will own the web app where planners track shipments in real time. Expect to design component architecture, improve performance on data-heavy screens, and raise the bar on accessibility and testing. You will pair closely with designers and backend engineers.

title: Backend Engineer, Routing
summary: Scale the services that plan and re-plan delivery routes across 40 countries.
description: Our routing platform processes millions of events a day. You will build event-driven services, tune PostgreSQL queries, and design APIs consumed by web, mobile and partner systems. On-call is shared and well supported.

title: Full-Stack Engineer, Customer Portal
summary: Ship features end to end in the portal where shippers book and track freight.
description: You will take features from idea to production: database schema, API, and polished UI. The team is small, ships weekly, and values pragmatic engineering over ceremony.

title: Machine Learning Engineer, ETA Prediction
summary: Make our arrival-time predictions the most accurate in the industry.
description: You will train, evaluate and deploy models that predict shipment arrival times using GPS, weather and traffic data. You will own the full lifecycle: feature pipelines, experiments, monitoring and drift detection.

title: Data Analyst, Network Performance
summary: Turn operational data into decisions for carriers and warehouse partners.
description: You will build dashboards, run analyses on on-time performance, and present findings to operations leaders. You will partner with data engineers on dbt models and define the metrics the business trusts.

title: Data Engineer
summary: Own the pipelines that feed analytics and machine learning at CareerLens.
description: You will design reliable batch and streaming pipelines, model data in Snowflake with dbt, and set the standards for data quality and observability across the company.

title: Senior Product Designer
summary: Design clear, calm tools for people who manage chaos for a living.
description: You will lead design for the carrier platform: interviewing dispatchers, mapping workflows, prototyping solutions and growing our design system. You will work as an equal partner to product and engineering.

title: Product Manager, Carrier Platform
summary: Decide what we build next for the carriers who move our customers' freight.
description: You will run discovery with carriers, define the roadmap, and work with a cross-functional squad to ship outcomes, not just features. You are comfortable with data and can write your own SQL to answer questions.

title: Platform Engineer (DevOps)
summary: Give every engineering team a fast, safe path to production.
description: You will run our Kubernetes platform on AWS, codify infrastructure in Terraform, and improve deployment pipelines and observability. You will treat internal engineers as your customers.

title: Mobile Engineer, Driver App
summary: Build the app drivers rely on in places with poor connectivity.
description: You will ship features for the driver app used on the road, including offline sync, proof of delivery, and navigation handoff. You care about battery, performance, and tiny screens.

title: Content Marketing Manager
summary: Tell the story of modern logistics to the people who buy and run it.
description: You will own our blog, guides and newsletters, plan content around search demand, and work with sales on case studies. You will measure what works and double down on it.

title: Account Executive, Enterprise
summary: Win and grow large shipper accounts across the UK and Ireland.
description: You will manage complex sales cycles with supply chain leaders, build business cases, and forecast accurately in Salesforce. Experience selling into logistics or supply chain is a strong plus.

title: Operations Analyst, Warehouse
summary: Find and fix bottlenecks in our partner warehouses.
description: You will spend time on the warehouse floor, analyse throughput data, and lead small improvement projects. You enjoy practical problem solving and explaining numbers to non-analysts.

title: QA Automation Engineer
summary: Build the safety net that lets us ship every day with confidence.
description: You will design end-to-end and API test suites, keep them fast and reliable in CI, and coach engineers on testing practices.

title: Application Security Engineer
summary: Keep customer and shipment data safe as we scale.
description: You will run threat modeling sessions, review code and architecture, manage our penetration testing program and support SOC 2 audits. You enable engineers rather than blocking them.

title: Technical Recruiter
summary: Help us hire the engineers, designers and analysts who will shape CareerLens.
description: You will partner with hiring managers, source candidates proactively, and run a respectful, well-organised process. You will help us tell our story to the market.
